subject: April commit sweep: Renewal risk scoring & stage confirmations
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: April commit sweep: Renewal risk scoring & stage confirmations

Team — quick hygiene sweep as we enter April. Finance asked for a tightened commit list for the April 8 forecast call. Please do the following by EOD Friday: 

- Confirm stage in HubSpot matches the attached tracker (Commit / Commit - at risk / Commit - conditional).
- Add a one-line justification for any account marked "at risk" (pricing, procurement timing, technical blockers).
- If you have a firm close date, update the Renewal Date field and set probability to the agreed commit percent.

I've attached the latest tracker. I ran an initial risk score sweep and flagged Acme Health as HIGH RISK due to procurement window slipping and an unresolved SOC 2 question. See my notes in column G.

Next steps: we will surface the cleaned commit list on the April 8 forecast call. If you need an exception, loop me and finance (monica) and include the mitigation plan.

Thanks — RK

Attachment: renewal_commit_tracker_Q2_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: April commit sweep: Renewal risk scoring & stage confirmations

Thanks Rachel — on it. Quick update for Acme Health: procurement just advised a legal hold on standard terms until mid-April because they need vendor security evidence for a cross-site audit. Julia in procurement said they want SOC 2 Type II evidence and a data retention statement.

I flagged Acme as "Commit - at risk" and added: "Procurement hold for SOC 2 evidence; target vendor review 4/15; legal to confirm."

I'll schedule a 20-min call with Julia to close open evidence gaps tomorrow and will try to move the review into the week of 4/6. If procurement pushes past 4/15, probability drops to 40%.

Sean

Adding my updates: 

- Acme Health: moved to "Commit - at risk". I added contact-level notes and referenced the PO timeline in HubSpot.
- BetaCo: confirmed renewable on 5/3; probability 85%; stage set to Commit.
- DeltaSys: legal negotiation continues; marked "Commit - conditional" and added expected cadence.

Also pasted below a quick checklist I used for stage validation so we keep consistency across the team: 

Checklist for Commit stage:
- Commercial terms agreed or in final redline
- Procurement has a target knockout date
- Exec sponsor confirmed (name & date)
- No open security gating items OR documented mitigation plan

I will tidy my entries in the tracker and upload a new version by EOD.

Laura
